privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: FlashCards is made by Ankit Kumar Pandit. This policy explains what the app stores and what you can do about it.

store.title: What we store
store.account: Your account: your email address, and, if you add them or sign in with Google, your name and profile photo link.
store.content: What you create: your sets, cards and labels.
store.settings: Settings such as language and dark mode stay on your device only.

use.title: How it is used
use.body: To sign you in and to show and save your sets. We don't use analytics, and we don't sell your data.

ads.title: Ads
ads.body: FlashCards shows ads from Google AdSense at the bottom of some screens, never while you study. Google and its partners use cookies and device identifiers to show and measure these ads, and may personalise them. If you are in the EEA, the UK or Switzerland, you are asked for your consent first. You can turn off personalised ads at {settings}, and read how Google uses this data at {partners}.

where.title: Where it is kept
where.body: With Google Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore), which stores it for us. Data travels encrypted.

delete.title: Deleting your data
delete.body: You can delete your account and everything in it from your profile in the app. Deletion is immediate and permanent; we keep no backups. If you can't sign in, see Delete account.

children.title: Children
children.body: FlashCards is meant for people aged 13 and over and is not directed at children under 13.

privacy.changes: If this policy changes, the date above changes with it.

deletion.title: Delete your FlashCards account
deletion.intro: Deleting your account removes your sign-in, your sets, cards and labels, straight away and for good. Nothing is kept.

app.title: In the app
app.body: Open your profile, choose Delete account, and confirm it's you.

email.title: Can't sign in?
email.body: Email {email} from the address on your account, asking to delete it. We delete it within 30 days and reply to confirm.

share.desc: Anyone with the link can view this set and copy it into their own library. Your progress is not shared.
